entries.400307c0c82db747: In April 2022, the company transferred each of its businesses to nine companies, including operating companies, through absorption-type company splits, and became a holding company. As of March 31, 2026, the company is composed mainly of itself and 446 consolidated subsidiaries. Operating companies such as Panasonic Connect Co., Ltd., Panasonic Industry Co., Ltd. and Panasonic Energy Co., Ltd. each take charge of a reportable segment.

entries.e42da9c0ccb84271: Panasonic Holdings Corporation is the holding company of a group consisting of a holding company and operating companies, and is composed mainly of the company and 446 consolidated subsidiaries. As a comprehensive electronics manufacturer, its product range covers nearly all electrical machinery and equipment, and it carries out development, production, sales and service activities in close cooperation with group companies in Japan and overseas. Production is in principle based on forecast-based production (make-to-stock), with production activities designed to keep product inventories at a certain required level, so production results are generally similar to sales results.
